import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/training_1.csv"
]

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_list = [pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0) for file in source_files]

# According to operation_history: UNION of Source1_2_0 and Source1_2_1
# Both sources have the same schema as target, so we can directly concat
df_union = pd.concat(df_list, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the exact order and types as target schema:
# Target Schema:
# ['tripduration': int, 'starttime': str, 'stoptime': str, 'start station id': int,
#  'start station name': str, 'start station latitude': float, 'start station longitude': float,
#  'end station id': int, 'end station name': str, 'end station latitude': float,
#  'end station longitude': float, 'bikeid': int, 'usertype': str, 'birth year': int, 'gender': int]

# Enforce column order
target_columns = [
    'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
    'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
    'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
]

df_union = df_union[target_columns]

# Convert columns to target types explicitly
df_union['tripduration'] = df_union['tripduration'].astype(int)
df_union['starttime'] = df_union['starttime'].astype(str)
df_union['stoptime'] = df_union['stoptime'].astype(str)
df_union['start station id'] = df_union['start station id'].astype(int)
df_union['start station name'] = df_union['start station name'].astype(str)
df_union['start station latitude'] = df_union['start station latitude'].astype(float)
df_union['start station longitude'] = df_union['start station longitude'].astype(float)
df_union['end station id'] = df_union['end station id'].astype(int)
df_union['end station name'] = df_union['end station name'].astype(str)
df_union['end station latitude'] = df_union['end station latitude'].astype(float)
df_union['end station longitude'] = df_union['end station longitude'].astype(float)
df_union['bikeid'] = df_union['bikeid'].astype(int)
df_union['usertype'] = df_union['usertype'].astype(str)
df_union['birth year'] = df_union['birth year'].astype(int)
df_union['gender'] = df_union['gender'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/target_multisource.csv"
df_union.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
